title: The platform owner signs in
goal: The platform owner reaches the platform console with the credentials the preparation issued for this run.

actors.description: Operates the platform and has oversight of every tenant.

preconditions: The end-to-end database was prepared in this run, with the platform owner's persona and a fresh password.

steps.intent: Sign in with the issued email and password
steps.outcome: The platform owner is signed in as themselves.
The console shows the platform overview.

steps.intent: Filter the error log, then reload the page
steps.outcome: The error log shows only the errors the filters match, and opens again with the same filters and errors, read from its address.

steps.intent: Follow a link to the error log with other filters while it is open
steps.outcome: The error log shows what the link names, not the filters it had.

steps.intent: Open a tenant's details from its console, then close them
steps.outcome: The address names the open tenant while its details are open and drops it once they are closed.

completion: The platform owner is on the platform console, signed in, not impersonating anyone, and the console's filters and open dialog live in its address.
